operator_path: From a clean checkout run frozen offline pytest including tests/controller. Use a temp SQLite file. No network after install.
must_scope: READY revision 2. Exactly once by (workspace_id, command_id). Full ControllerCommand RFC 8785 fingerprint via content_hash/canonical_json. Different fingerprint is a security conflict. Do not copy PR #22.

controller/transaction_store.py: ControllerTransactionStore Protocol, records, PersistenceError. controller/kernel.py: KernelController(store, recorded_at=...). read stays UNKNOWN revision 0. Never datetime.now.

persistence/kernel_memory.py and persistence/kernel_sqlite.py implement the same port. SQLite uses SQLAlchemy Core, WAL, single writer, explicit BEGIN, Alembic initial revision for inbox/events/pipelines snapshot. No root runtime dependencies.

CONFIRM_REQUIREMENT requires payload key text (str). REJECT_REQUIREMENT requires payload key reason (str). Missing/wrong type or unknown command_type -> REJECTED VALIDATION_ERROR message unsupported command, no durable write.

Load pipelines row or UNCONFIRMED revision 0 empty text. Call domain.apply. EMPTY_REQUIREMENT -> REJECTED VALIDATION_ERROR empty requirement. INVALID_TRANSITION -> REJECTED VALIDATION_ERROR invalid transition. ACCEPTED writes inbox, one event, updated pipelines snapshot, returns ACCEPTED receipt with observed_revision = new revision and one evt_ event_id.

Inbox PK is (workspace_id, command_id) storing full-command fingerprint and receipt_json. Same pair + same fingerprint -> original stored receipt (do not rewrite to DEDUPLICATED). Same pair + different fingerprint -> CONFLICT CONFLICT command identity conflict. expected_revision != current pipelines.revision (missing row = 0) -> CONFLICT CONFLICT expected revision conflict before apply, no Event.

Persistence failure including SQLITE_FULL -> REJECTED INTERNAL_ERROR persistence unavailable retryable=true and no leftover partial rows. Adapter translates driver errors to PersistenceError; receipts never carry SQL or paths.

Restart: close store, new SqliteKernelStore same path, same (workspace_id, command_id) + same full fingerprint returns the stored receipt; events stay one row. Cross-workspace same command_id both ACCEPTED.
Do not import counter_spike, spike_controller, sqlite_spike, or _persistence_port. Leave 00-04 files KEEP_MARKED_EVIDENCE. Do not change domain/pipeline.py semantics.
Tests in tests/controller/test_kernel_submit.py run the same suite on memory and SQLite. Export KernelController from controller/__init__.py.
out_of_scope: Projection rebuild and real ControllerPort.read fields
prohibited_actions: Import spike_controller, CounterSpike, sqlite_spike, or _persistence_port into the kernel
Commit, push, merge, rebase, or alter remotes

data: Disposable SQLite files in tests only.
migration: New kernel tables; no production Workspace migration.
security: No raw sqlite errors in CommandReceipt.message.

acceptance_criteria.observable_result: Accepted CONFIRM_REQUIREMENT persists one inbox row, one event, and pipelines.status OPEN.
Restart plus same (workspace_id, command_id) and full-command fingerprint returns the stored receipt unchanged and does not add a second event.
Identity and revision conflicts and domain rejections use the fixed messages; persistence failure is non-durable.
Existing offline pytest and pyright still pass.

required_tests: Restart replay on a new SQLite store instance
Shared contract tests on memory and SQLite
demonstration: Submit a confirm, kill the store, reopen, resubmit: one event, same receipt.

risks.mitigation: Import-boundary test forbids CounterSpike and spike_controller.

stop_conditions: Atomic inbox+event+pipelines cannot be done behind ControllerTransactionStore
A new dependency family is required
